Name: Over Grown Farm Cave
Author: RaffieJohn
Description:
Hello!

This is my first mod ever!

I never liked the fact the farm cave was small, and you could only get at least 20 fruits max without going to the cave for days. 


Compatibility:
It should be good as long as you don't have another mod that edits the farm cave map.
SVE IRF2 is compatible!



Special thanks to my friends and the SDV Discord!

The mods I use in the images:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10018]Better Farm Cave Forage
[/url]

Downloads.Description: Just put this into your mods folder after you unzip it.
